title: cat eating steak with doom eternal music playing

segments.description: Wide shot of a large raw steak being placed into a clear glass dish on a white table [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=1)].
Medium close-up of a tiny white and cream kitten eagerly tearing into the raw steak as intense heavy metal music begins [[00:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=4)].
Close-up tracking shot of the kitten viciously gnawing on the bone with aggressive comedic intensity [[00:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=18)].
Medium action shot of the kitten tugging and pulling furiously on the meat while maintaining a fierce expression [[00:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=35)].
Close-up shot of a hand lifting the bone while the kitten continues chewing tenaciously [[00:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=54)].
Medium tracking shot of the kitten pouncing and aggressively ripping apart the raw steak in the dish [[01:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=70)].
Close-up shot of scissors cutting up the remaining steak while the kitten watches closely [[01:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=102)].
Medium shot of the kitten enthusiastically devouring the smaller pieces of meat in the glass container [[01:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=112)].
Close-up action shot of the kitten licking up juices and finishing its meal before walking away [[02:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=130)].
Medium shot of the kitten being fed meat puree from a small white spoon [[02:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=145)].
Wide action shot transitioning to an adult Bengal cat aggressively tearing into a new raw steak under pounding metal music [[03:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=182)].
Medium tracking shot of the Bengal cat licking the dish clean and walking away off-screen as the video concludes [[03:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTtUmBRqKxI&t=223)].
